IShellUIHelper::ImportExportFavorites Method

Handles the importing and exporting of Microsoft® Internet Explorer favorites.

Syntax

HRESULT ImportExportFavorites(
    VARIANT_BOOL fImport,
    BSTR strImpExpPath
);

Parameters

fImport
VARIANT_BOOL value that specifies if this is an import or export operation. VARIANT_TRUE indicates an import operation, while VARIANT_FALSE indicates an export operation.
strImpExpPath
String value that contains the path to the location of the import or export file.

Return Value

Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code otherwise.

Remarks

Favorites that reference local files are not created during import. They are filtered out without comment and the program continues.

The ImportExportFavorites method imports favorites from or exports favorites to an HTML page in the Netscape bookmark format.
